sql: SELECT c.card_id,c.name FROM card c WHERE c.language='ja' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_card_facet f WHERE f.card_id=c.card_id AND f.facet_type='dex_id' AND f.value='25') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_card_facet f WHERE f.card_id=c.card_id AND f.facet_type='illustrator' AND f.value='Yuka Morii') ORDER BY c.card_id
scope: Zero matching current source-facet intersection does not prove no such physical card exists.
